messages:
alex: Heads-up — onboarding new tenant 'acme-ml' needs GPU quota + capacity. Subscription redwood-prod-42 needs +8 Standard_ND40rs_v2 in westeurope and a subnet IP limit bump for the inference nodes. I'll open a support ticket with Azure and link it here.
maria: Can you paste the subscription id and who the tenant owner is? Also need the expected steady-state vCPU/GPU numbers for cost commit justification.
alex: Sub ID: 3f4a6b8c-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-9a7b6c5d2e1f. Owner: @sophie (on legal/contract side). Expected steady-state: 8 GPUs, burst to 12 for batch evals; avg seq len ~1024, batch size 4.
raj: Tagging infra-net: if we're increasing subnet IPs we need NSG review and possible route table validation. Also suggest adding francecentral as a fallback region in case westeurope capacity is tight.
sophie: noted re legal/owner. I'll coordinate approvals. For the subnet change we need to request vNet / subnet quota increase (IPs) and confirm there are free /28s in that VN.
devops-bot: Azure support ticket created: AZ-2025-998877. Link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/HubsExtension/BrowseSupportTickets/ticketId/AZ-2025-998877 (created by alex)
raj: For the request body, include the SKU names and a short description of production inference workload. Example CLI to check current quota in region:
```bash
az vm list-usage --location westeurope --output table
```
Also include the capacity reservation request (if we want guaranteed ND40rs). We normally create a capacity-reservation CR and attach to the subscription.
alex: Created CR: CR-2025-331 (90-day reservation request for 8 ND40rs). Linked in ticket. I've asked MS to evaluate region availability and to provide a timeline.
sophie: Networking — I'll run the IP inventory and confirm whether we need to carve a new subnet or resize. If resize required, expect ~24h lead time for routing + firewall rule sync.
infra-eng-bot: Reminder: please include a short perf profile for scheduler: "throughput target 200 tokens/s per node, 99th pct latency < 200ms", plus model family (meta/opt-6.7b-like). This speeds up quota approvals.
alex: Added perf profile and model family to the ticket notes. Pinging support engineer (cc: @maria) for priority handling.
maria: Also flag cost control: propose autoscale start/stop windows and burst policy to limit spend — put config in the ticket notes so procurement can pre-approve.
alex: Done. I've also attached the cost estimate and autoscale policy draft. Will post updates from AZ-2025-998877 here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
